messages:
micah: Heads-up: slight agenda shuffle for today's all-hands. Moving roadmap demo to 10:02 and opening Q&A at 10:18. Pls watch for sticky in #lobby.

marco-av: Acknowledged. Doing a quick camera/capture sync. Saw a dropped frame loop during final rehearsal on Cam B. Will try software reconnect.

kelsey: Can we enable captions early? Some remote folks asked for live captions at the start of Q&A.

micah: Yes — enable captions at meetup start. Sam, can you confirm CC provider has keys?

sam: CC provider renewed yesterday. I’ll toggle captions to ON at go-time and monitor latency.

anya: I’ll post a short note in #lobby: "Agenda update + captions ON. Q&A opens ~10:18. Upvote questions in the thread."

marco-av: Update: forced Cam B reconnect helped but still a 1-2s desync between slide deck and camera when presenter switches slides rapidly. Recommend we lock presenter to single laptop for demo.

micah: Good call. Kelsey, can you be the single presenter for the demo segment? We'll have someone cue slide changes manually if needed.

kelsey: Happy to. DM me slide numbers if you want a different order.

ingest-bot: Stream monitor: ingest latency 300ms, packet loss 0.1% over last 5m. Automated failover threshold set to 5% loss or 5s sustained gap.

marco-av: Failover plan for ops: 1) attempt software recon on Cam B 2) if gap >2s for 20s, cut camera and continue slides 3) if OBS crashes, fail to backup ingest. Command to trigger rehost below.

marco-av: ```
# Rehost to backup ingest
ssh ops@streambox "curl -X POST https://ingest-backup.internal/v1/failover?stream=all-hands"
```

micah: For Q&A logistics: we'll seed two leadership questions first (roadmap priorities and Dedicated capacity pricing), then open the thread for upvotes. Jen, can you join for the first 5 minutes?

anya: I'll pin the two seeded prompts in the Q&A thread now so folks can vote. Also creating a "parking lot" note for any deep-dive items.

sam: Camera stable after hot-restart; monitoring audio levels too. If audio shows >250ms jitter for 30s, move to audio-only mode for the call.

kelsey: Noted. If we go audio-only, please call it out in #lobby and keep captions on.

micah: After the meeting I'll post a follow-up with Q&A answers and any slide changes. If anybody on stage needs a last-second slide tweak, DM marco-av with `slide:<num>` and I'll approve.

anya: Sticky posted in #lobby. Also posted link to the Q&A thread and instructions: upvote questions, avoid duplicates.

marco-av: Final preflight looks good. Switching to live layout in 60s. Good luck everyone. :thumbsup:
